fusions.name: Razor Load
fusions.desc: Fires a bladed round at a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 9 damage and leave the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fan of Edges
fusions.desc: Fires 5 bladed rounds in a fan, each dealing 6 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Quick Draw
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Underbarrel Blade
fusions.desc: Conjures a blade fixed beneath your barrel: your weapon damage rises by 10% and you attack 5% faster, and every strike leaves [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 3 ticks.
